description.value: A BC Parks campground on Lac la Hache in the Cariboo, offering lakeside access and a calm interior-plateau setting; reservations are accepted and potable water is on-site, making it a reliable planned stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website URL confirms this is a legitimate BC Parks property (Cedar Point Park), but the fetched content rendered only the site-wide navigation menu with no park-specific details, so amenities cannot be confirmed from the website. OSM tags establish 29-site capacity, a fee, no power supply, and a sanitary dump station; however, per rules, OSM amenity tags are not treated as authoritative without website corroboration. The email domain (sherwood@thelakebc.ca / thelakebc.ca) is inconsistent with a government-managed BC Parks site and warrants a flag.
concerns: The OSM email (sherwood@thelakebc.ca) uses the domain thelakebc.ca, which does not correspond to a BC government address — it may belong to a nearby private resort or operator rather than this BC Parks campsite, and should be verified before publishing.
The fetched website content rendered only the BC Parks site-wide navigation without any Cedar Point-specific page text, preventing confirmation of any individual amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, publicly accessible BC Parks campsite with 29 sites; confirmed open via the official BC Parks website URL.
